roster.note: spent thirteen years in orbit at Saturn — the only spacecraft ever to do so — mapping the rings, the moons, and the storms in detail no flyby could reach

roster.name: Huygens lands on Titan
roster.note: the European Huygens probe parachuted onto Titan in January 2005 — the first and only landing anywhere in the outer solar system

roster.name: The geysers of Enceladus
roster.note: Cassini found jets of water ice erupting from the south pole of the tiny moon Enceladus, evidence of a global ocean beneath its ice — one of the most promising places to look for life

roster.name: The Grand Finale
roster.note: out of fuel, Cassini was flown between Saturn and its rings twenty-two times and then deliberately plunged into the planet, to be sure it could never contaminate the ocean moons
